children: At its annual innovation and customer success conference, Calix, Inc. (
) announced the seven winners of its 15th annual Partner Innovations Awards. The awards recognize partners helping
service providers turn technology investments into measurable business results through automation, specialized expertise, and operational innovation.

The Calix partner ecosystem gives service providers the support needed to adopt and maximize the AI-native Calix One™ platform and SmartLife™ managed services. These seven award winners demonstrate how the right combination of technology, operational innovation, and execution helps providers accelerate service delivery, reduce costs, strengthen subscriber relationships, and compete and win across residential, business, community, and multifamily markets.
The 2026 Calix Partner Innovations Award winners demonstrate measurable impact:
Channel Partner Award—Nexicom Systems grows Calix business 160 percent in two years.

For over 14 years, Nexicom Systems has partnered with Calix to support more than 16 mutual customers across Canada, including rural providers and community-owned networks. Their longstanding customer relationships and investment in Calix expertise have made Nexicom the leading channel partner in Canada, and a top five partner globally since 2024.
Customer Choice Award—CDG helps providers turn automation into measurable gains, including 52 percent fewer outage-related calls.

Through their work with Communications Data Group (CDG), service providers are achieving exceptional results: Clearwave Fiber used automated notifications that contributed to a 20-point Net Promoter Score℠ (NPS®) increase; Firefly Fiber Broadband added 12,000 accounts in 14 months without increasing staff, supported by automated provisioning and Calix integrations; and Home Telecom reduced provisioning labor 27 percent and customer service calls 15 percent using automation, while generating tens of thousands in additional monthly recurring revenue.
Ecosystem Partner Award—Paymentus enables service activation in less than a minute while reducing cost to serve by up to 90 percent.

Paymentus co-developed the reusable paywall solution with Calix, combining payment processing and self-service activation for SmartMDU™ and SmartTown®. Providers can offer flexible service packages and payment options without manual activation work or technician dispatches.
Excellence in Partner Innovation Award—gaiia accelerates operational integration up to 75 percent faster than the industry standard.

gaiia enabled providers to adopt Calix-integrated operations in three to six months, up to 75 percent faster than the industry benchmark. Their low-code Workflow Builder connects Calix capabilities with billing and operational systems, allowing providers to automate provisioning, device management, and subscriber lifecycle changes without custom coding.
Excellence in Partner Training Award—JSI resolves 91 percent of Calix-related support calls
on first contact.

With more than 150 Calix certifications held by over 50 employees, JSI equips their teams to deliver faster, more effective technical engineering and design services. Every contact center technical support employee is Calix certified, giving their team deep familiarity with Calix solutions and technologies. JSI also helped develop the Calix certified partner program for service support.
Partner Market Impact Award—Nex-Tech Creative grows affordability program enrollment 44 percent
in three months.
Using

subscriber and demographic insights, Nex-Tech Creative identified households at risk of switching providers and introduced targeted outreach with a $30 monthly discount. The team also prioritized the replacement of aging routers, completing 119 no-cost upgrades within weeks. Nex-Tech applies the same data-driven approach to their
work with other providers.
Rising Partner Star of the Year Award—CSSA extends Calix One capabilities and dedicated sales support to providers with 500 or fewer subscribers.

The Communications Supply Service Association (CSSA), a member-driven buying cooperative, draws on more than 50 years of service to rural and community providers—pairing a member-driven buying association with Calix One capabilities. The new partnership with Calix gives providers a focused resource for technology decisions, personalized support, and growth.
John Durocher, chief operating officer at Calix, said:

“The best technology is only the starting point. These seven partners prove what happens when automation, specialized expertise, and operational discipline come together on the Calix One platform to help service providers achieve faster activation, lower cost to serve, and happier subscribers. Whether a provider serves 500 or 500,000 subscribers, our partner ecosystem helps them turn every investment into measurable results. Congratulations to this year’s winners.”

See all Partner Innovations Award winners and finalists from ConneXions 2026 and learn how Calix partners are helping service providers improve operations, better serve their subscribers, and grow their businesses.
About Calix
Calix, Inc. (

) is an AI platform company that enables service providers to transform their operations and accelerate delivery of differentiated experiences—so they can compete and win in the markets and communities they serve.

Through the AI-native Calix One platform, service providers can securely and privately activate agentic AI alongside their human teams to acquire new subscribers, grow existing subscriber revenue, and build loyalty across residential, business, municipal, and MDU markets. More than 1,200 customers of all sizes leverage the Calix One platform, which has evolved over 15 years at an investment of more than $2 billion.

Calix innovation cycles are underpinned by a strong financial balance sheet and a people‑first culture that routinely earns broad industry recognition—winning 81 culture and innovation awards since 2025 alone, as well as Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026.
